name: soprano
source:
A pianist training and nurturing game. How far can you decipher the stories hidden behind the feelings of the various characters?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151025175335/http://pulsenotes.org/products.php]the official website[/url]]
translation:
钢琴家训练和培养游戏。你能在多大程度上解读隐藏在各个角色感情背后的故事？

[翻译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151025175335/http://pulsenotes.org/products.php]官网[/url]]
